protocol.supervised_vanilla: Random warm-up; contrast+detection; same scalar heads; fixed loss pair selected on seed21 development; no controller or mask initialization
protocol.extra_variants: Both released and paper-equation unsupervised adapters, COCO supporting stage
protocol.train_mapping: Same TRAIN-only group selection policy after reconstruction warm-up; category slots not hardwired into supervision
protocol.endpoints: Fixed 10640 updates; fixed-weight hyperparameter selection on development only, not endpoint cherry-picking
protocol.baseline_settings: Three full-budget fixed-weight candidates; extra unsupervised variants at common Adam LR0.0003 and paper lasso coefficient0.001, NOT tuned or native ImageNet replication
protocol.evaluation: Previously inspected COCO1500 audit; independently trained VOC2012 models evaluated on official validation
protocol.voc: Official train partitioned FIT/development by fixed hash; own FIT-only normalization, mask initialization and mappings; COCO architecture/cap/update defaults; no GGF VOC sweep
protocol.interpretability: TRAIN-selected 1/2/4 native contribution groups; held-out capture, same-group AP, fixed linear-probe removal with activity/RMS-neighbor random controls; active coefficient/contribution rank and direction atlas
protocol.additional_supervised: Pinned released Concept-SAE task adaptation, all three stages/three seeds on COCO and VOC; separate native budget/parameter count
protocol.uncertainty: Seed SD and Student-t95; paired whole-image bootstrap1000 and seed differences; retain all declared categories
protocol.order: COCO primary+analysis, VOC training+analysis, Concept-SAE, supporting unsupervised variants
